example.title: Net shed D-8 at Fishermen's Terminal (left)
example.place: Fishermen's Terminal, Seattle, King County, WA

brief: A 1980s net shed: a long single-storey building of white corrugated metal with a low gable, roll-up doors for each gear locker, a lettered shed number over the door. One photo (the left-hand shed). Foundations taken deeper than needed (spec rule 4).
